matrix_failure_revision.policy: Matrix deltaf<=delta0 completes local nonviscous damage; compatible modes retain linear softening. Existing viscosity and UPDATE retained. Vessel failure uses fiber_completion only; matrix completion never triggers it.
matrix_failure_revision.energy_limit: Instantaneous matrix completion is not exact dissipation of input fracture energy.
matrix_failure_revision.prior_evidence: All pre-existing gate_evidence and validation reports refer to the earlier implementation, not this revision.

fiber_onset_revision.cause: 1022: FC Hashin stress branch S11<0 can coincide with E11>=0 under coupled multiaxial loading; old DEL2 then equals zero.
fiber_onset_revision.change: FC uses stress-equivalent displacement LC*max(-S11,0)/PROPS(1) and equivalent stress max(-S11,0). Material caps are CAPF=0.95 and CAPM=0.85 in next INP, preserving residual normal stiffness while SDV damage may reach 1.
fiber_onset_revision.prior_runs: Prior solve and validation reports refer to other source hashes.
